note: Fictional company and people. Everything below is what Larkspur's support team keeps as training memory: procedures, policies, and the questions earlier cohorts asked with the answers a senior agent gave.
procedures: Larkspur support hours are 7am to 7pm Central, Monday to Friday.
Enterprise customers have a named technical account manager.
Use the macro 'Billing - card declined' for failed card payments.
Never share another customer's data, even with the same company domain, without an admin's approval.
Chargebacks are handled by the finance team, not by support.
Data export requests are fulfilled within 3 business days.
Account deletion requests must be confirmed by the account owner by email.
Tier 2 is reachable in the #support-tier2 channel.
Outage status is posted on status.larkspur.example.
Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.
Seats can be added at any time and are prorated.
Monthly plans are not refundable; cancelling stops the next renewal.
Tickets tagged 'security' go straight to the security on-call.
Agents must tag every ticket with a product area before closing it.
The Starter plan has email support only; Pro adds chat.
Phone support is available only on Enterprise.
Invoices can be re-sent from the billing admin page.
Tax-exempt status requires a certificate uploaded by the customer.
SSO setup issues go to the identity specialist, Priya Raman.
New agents shadow a senior agent for their first five shifts.

policies.label: Annual-plan refund window
policies.v1: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase.
policies.v2: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase.
policies.noted: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase (changed on 2026-10-14; before that it was 30 days).

policies.label: Billing-dispute escalation
policies.v1: Billing disputes over $500 must be escalated to Tier 2.
policies.v2: Billing disputes over $200 must be escalated to Tier 2.
policies.noted: Billing disputes over $200 must be escalated to Tier 2 (changed on 2026-10-14; before that the threshold was $500).

policies.label: Trial extensions
policies.v1: Agents may extend a free trial by up to 7 days without approval.
policies.v2: Agents may extend a free trial by up to 3 days without approval.
policies.noted: Agents may extend a free trial by up to 3 days without approval (changed on 2026-10-14; before that it was 7 days).

policies.label: Pro first-response SLA
policies.v1: Pro plan tickets get a first response within 8 business hours.
policies.v2: Pro plan tickets get a first response within 4 business hours.
policies.noted: Pro plan tickets get a first response within 4 business hours (changed on 2026-10-14; before that it was 8 hours).

policies.label: Goodwill credits
policies.v1: Agents may issue a goodwill credit of up to $50 per account per quarter.
policies.v2: Agents may issue a goodwill credit of up to $25 per account per quarter.
policies.noted: Agents may issue a goodwill credit of up to $25 per account per quarter (changed on 2026-10-14; before that it was $50).

qa.q: Annual-plan customer bought three weeks ago and wants a full refund, can I approve it?
qa.a: Yes, approve it: annual plans are fully refundable for 30 days.
qa.a2: No: annual plans are fully refundable only within 14 days.

qa.q: Customer disputes a $300 charge, do I escalate?
qa.a: No, handle it yourself: only disputes over $500 go to Tier 2.
qa.a2: Yes: disputes over $200 go to Tier 2.

qa.q: Prospect wants their trial extended by 5 days, can I do it without approval?
qa.a: Yes, go ahead: agents can extend trials by up to 7 days on their own.
qa.a2: No, get approval first: agents can extend trials by up to 3 days on their own.

qa.q: Pro ticket is 6 business hours old with no reply, has it breached the SLA?
qa.a: No, not yet: the Pro first-response target is 8 business hours.
qa.a2: Yes: the Pro first-response target is 4 business hours.

qa.q: Can I give a $40 credit after an outage?
qa.a: Yes: goodwill credits up to $50 per account per quarter are fine.
qa.a2: No: goodwill credits are capped at $25 per account per quarter.

qa.q: Customer's SSO login loops back to the sign-in page, who takes it?
qa.a: Send it to Priya Raman, the identity specialist.

qa.q: How fast do we owe a customer their data export?
qa.a: Within 3 business days of the request.

qa.q: A user emails asking to delete the whole account, can I just do it?
qa.a: Only after the account owner confirms by email.

qa.q: Monthly customer wants last month's charge refunded, can I?
qa.a: No, monthly plans are not refundable; cancel so the next renewal stops.

qa.q: Customer says they filed a chargeback with their bank, what do I do?
qa.a: Hand it to finance; support does not handle chargebacks.

qa.q: Customer reports a possible leaked API token, who do I page?
qa.a: Tag the ticket 'security'; it goes straight to the security on-call.

qa.q: Customer downgraded today, do they lose Pro features right away?
qa.a: No, the downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

questions.say: A customer on an annual plan bought it 20 days ago and wants a full refund. Can I approve it?
A customer is disputing a $350 charge. Do I have to escalate it to Tier 2?
A customer asks for a 5-day trial extension. Can I grant it without approval?
A Pro ticket came in 6 business hours ago and nobody has replied yet. Has it breached the first-response SLA?
Can I give this customer a $40 goodwill credit for the outage?
